And here they were, spread out like landmines for my feelings: every sordid or saccharine detail laid bare on those pages...some part of a story my own partner chose to live in while pretending it wasn't real.

topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
story:
Cass held back by force of habit as Max leaned over her shoulders during their morning routine. It still felt natural, this shared space full of intimacy and affection that suddenly made every second feel like twisted mockery.

One moment he'd be telling a story; the next, they were living one – but to my surprise: in his warped little vision, ours was all about me.

He caught our reflection in the mirror above the counter – maybe a part of him noticed I looked...different. My lips pressed shut to keep whatever venom inside from escaping was no doubt misinterpreted for 'caring support'.

That's what I told myself.

As always, it seemed my heart needed more practice telling the truth...

But all Cass managed to let slip through that thin skin around her mouth before hastily grabbing her bag and heading out the door was a single low whisper: "Write about me like this?"

And nothing.

Not even him.
